title: read_schema
description: Read a registry as field names and types (default) or in full (detail=true). source=local: the customer's rows. source=canonical: the operator's baseline; omit registry to list them.

source.description: local: this customer's registry DDB. canonical: the operator's baseline.

registry.description: Which registry. Required when source=local; with source=canonical omit it to list every registry there is.

detail.description: false (default): each field as name and type — what a write needs. true: the entries as stored — description, enum, class, origin — when you need what a field means.
